title: Solar Eclipse
headline: Drake's 'Solar Eclipse' borrows a country chorus from Ella Langley
caption:
"Solar Eclipse" also interpolates "Get Throwed", the Bun B song featuring Pimp C, Z-Ro, Young Jeezy and Jay-Z.

Drake name-checks Johnny Manziel and the Woodlands alongside Sugar Land and Pearland, and Don Toliver shouts out Katy and Fort Bend County. The song was previewed in FOMO, the short film Drake premiered on YouTube, before landing on the Habibti (FOMO) reissue. Akademiks puts Drake giving up his publishing share down to popular demand.

🎧 The song: "Solar Eclipse" by Drake (@champagnepapi)
